pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Customer has changed their contact detail? Make sure you preform a maintenance request to update customer profile.
  • Looking to further build that relationship with your customer? Create a future task to check on how things are going.

• Having trouble to contact customer? Ensure Customer contact details are correct on customer profile
  • Have you tried a different contact method? 
  • Has customer changed their contact detail? Make sure you perform a maintenance request to update customer profile.
  • Ready to convert the lead? Please ensure you have collected as much detail as you can from your customer.

• Missing Customer contact details? Try view Customer profile and ensure the correct Contact is load against the customer profile.
  • High risk customer? Make sure you view customer details (i.e. PI Scores, Risk Grades) prior making a contact
  • Need more information on the lead? Check out the Related tab.
• Want to make a Referral? Make sure you have the correct customer details and provide as much detail on customer needs as possible.
